meta.protocol: 2026+ dropped at parse (tools/ml2.py wrapper); every choice by forward-chained CV < 2024 (tune folds 2016-2019, nested selection 2017-2023, stack gate 2021-2023, 0.0005 rule); 2024-01-01..2025-12-31 scored once (holdout marker); corner-swap test passed
meta.decision: NOT ADOPTED (stack gate failed); monitored candidate
meta.cells: per fight: R-round layout A KO r1..R, A SUB r1..R, B KO r1..R, B SUB r1..R, A DEC, B DEC, draw; bins7 [A KO, A SUB, A DEC, draw, B DEC, B SUB, B KO]; p_a = the ML v2 winner it conditions on

gate.rule: enter if pooled 2021-2023 7-bin of the blend < S2+ml2win - 0.0005 (beta per year fit on OOF rows 2017..Y-1, grid 0..1 by 0.05)

stage2.rule: enter if pooled 2021-2023 7-bin < S2+ml2win - 0.0005 at lam 1.0

js_model.what: finishing model (monitored candidate; not adopted by the stack gate): P(cell) = pA x P(method | winner) x P(round | winner, method); method = multinomial logit over [KO, SUB, DEC] on the winner-oriented design; round = continuation-ratio logit over rounds on the finisher-oriented design

round.dummies: 12 free columns after the covariates (and their (j-1)/2 slopes when slope): index (j-1)*2+m for 3-round bouts, 4+(j-1)*2+m for 5-round bouts; j = round 1..R-1, m = 0 KO / 1 SUB; P(round R) = the remainder

js_model.cells: R5 layout: A KO r1..5, A SUB r1..5, B KO r1..5, B SUB r1..5, A DEC, B DEC, draw

fin_features.zW: logit(P(W wins)) from the ML v2 winner (A side: logit pA, B side: -logit pA)
fin_features.w_<rate>: the winner's EB posterior mean (log-odds shift) for the rate
fin_features.l_<rate>: the loser's EB posterior mean for the rate
